action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8080/admin/dashboard" -o dash.html -w "dashboard: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o -i 'dashboard' dash.html | head -2
echo "--- /admin (should now go to dashboard, not bootstrap) ---"
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -o /dev/null -w "[%{http_code}] loc=[%{redirect_url}]\n" "http://localhost:8080/admin"
